Presentation.Title: The Easyness Expertise
Presentation.Subtitle: Tailored administrative support, designed to make your life simpler.
Presentation.Paragraph1: Easyness supports individuals and professionals through all of their administrative procedures, with a clear, responsive approach and no unnecessary jargon.
Presentation.Paragraph2: From putting together a tax file to managing an estate, through accounting, financial, commercial, or real estate follow-up, our team handles every step with rigor.
Presentation.Paragraph3: When a case requires in-depth legal expertise, we rely on a network of partner lawyers, ensuring every client gets complete, secure support from first contact through to resolution.

Domains.PageSubtitle: Comprehensive support, whatever your need. Discover how we can help you.

juridique.Title: Legal
juridique.Intro: Clear legal support to safeguard every step of your procedures.
juridique.Description: We help you understand and carry out your legal procedures, whether related to contracts, disputes or administrative formalities. Our partner network of lawyers steps in whenever your case requires specific expertise.
Services: Review and drafting of contractual documents
Introduction to a partner lawyer when needed

fiscal.Title: Taxation
fiscal.Intro: Optimise and secure your tax situation with peace of mind.
fiscal.Description: From income tax returns to more complex tax situations, we help you understand your obligations and optimise your taxation in full compliance with current regulations.
Services: Support in the event of a tax audit
Personalised advice based on your profile

comptable.Title: Accounting
comptable.Intro: Rigorous accounting management to simplify your daily life.
comptable.Description: We take care of tracking your accounts, preparing your accounting documents, and directing you to the right contacts for sound, transparent management of your activity or assets.
Services: Tracking and organising your accounting documents

financier.Title: Financial
financier.Intro: Tailored financial advice to build your projects with confidence.
financier.Description: Whether for financing, investment, or reorganising your finances, we help you gain clarity and make the best decisions for your situation.

commercial.Title: Commercial
commercial.Intro: Support with your commercial and contractual procedures.
commercial.Description: We support you in structuring and managing your business relationships, drafting your contracts, and handling the procedures related to your activity.
Services: Follow-up of your commercial administrative procedures

patrimonial.Title: Estate Planning
patrimonial.Intro: Protect and pass on your assets with complete confidence.
patrimonial.Description: Succession, transfer, estate organisation: we support you every step of the way to protect your assets and prepare calmly for your family's future.
Services: Advice on estate organisation and transfer
Coordination with partner notaries and lawyers

bancaire.Title: Banking
bancaire.Intro: Concrete support for your banking procedures.
bancaire.Description: Account opening, financing, relations with your bank: we help simplify your exchanges and best defend your interests.

immobilier.Title: Property & Rental Projects
immobilier.Intro: Complete support for your property and rental projects.
immobilier.Description: Buying, selling, renting or managing a rental property: we support you at every stage of your property project, with rigorous and personalised administrative follow-up.
Services: Support with buying or selling procedures
Administrative follow-up of your property project
